pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ tǎ wéi jiāo de tú fàngdào zhuōshàng , xiān wèn túlǐ nàge nǐng luógǎn de rén shì shuí .
pairs.english: Vey laid Tavi's submitted drawing on the table and first asked who the person turning the screw in the drawing was.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把塔维交的图放到桌上，先问图里那个拧螺杆的人是谁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō ruò zhǔnxǔ , xiǎng qǐng mǐlā .
pairs.english: Tavi said he would ask Mira if allowed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说若准许，想请米拉。

pairs.target: lǎoshī jiāng bǐ gēxià , ràng tā qù wèn rén , bié zài zhǐ shàng xiān tì biérén liú yì shuāngshǒu .
pairs.english: Putting down her pen, the teacher told him to ask her first, not reserve another person's hands on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 老师将笔搁下，让他去问人，别在纸上先替别人留一双手。

pairs.target: mǐlā láide bǐ tā yùxiǎng de kuài , shǒulǐ què méikòng zhe .
pairs.english: Mira came sooner than he expected, but her hands weren't empty.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉来得比他预想的快，手里却没空着。

pairs.target: tā bào zhe zìjǐ tóng sū yǐ de shìjiàn tú , wèn jīnrì jiūjìng shì qǐng tā kàn tú , háishì yòu jiào tā fàngxià zìjǐ de huó lái tì tā shì yìhuí .
pairs.english: She was carrying her and Suyi's prototype drawings. Was she being asked to inspect a drawing today or put aside her own work for his trial again?
pairs.hanzi: 她抱着自己同苏苡的试件图，问今日究竟是请她看图，还是又叫她放下自己的活来替他试一回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng chū tā yǒudiǎn bù gāoxìng , máng shuō xiān kàn tú , shì yào děng lǎoshī jiāng liǎngbiān dōu kàn míngbái , shíjiān yě dé tā kěn .
pairs.english: Hearing her annoyance, Tavi said inspect first; a trial required the teacher's assessment of both sides and her agreement to the time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听出她有点不高兴，忙说先看图，试要等老师将两边都看明白，时间也得她肯。

pairs.target: tú shàng réng shì yuánlái nà duì xiǎo tiěliào , zhěngkuài tǐjī tóng xiāngróngxìng yǐyǒu jìlù , jīnrì bìng bù yīncǐ miǎn chá .
pairs.english: The drawing still used the original small iron pair. Compatibility and whole volumes were recorded, not exempted from rechecking.
pairs.hanzi: 图上仍是原来那对小铁料，整块体积同相容性已有记录，今日并不因此免查。

pairs.target: yào zhuāng de shì yíjiàn pǔtōng mù múxíng de jiāchí zuò , tiěliào yǔ jiājù zhī zuò zhuāngpèi shí de gōngjù ; luógǎn suǒzhù yǐhòu , mù jiàn kào jīxiè kǎkǒu liúxià wèizhì , búshì yào jiè xìng liúzài mùtou lǐ .
pairs.english: The job was an ordinary wooden model's clamping seat; iron and fixture were assembly tools only. Once the screw locked, a mechanical catch held the wood, not borrowing left inside it.
pairs.hanzi: 要装的是一件普通木模型的夹持座，铁料与夹具只作装配时的工具；螺杆锁住以后，木件靠机械卡口留下位置，不是要借性留在木头里。

pairs.target: liǎngkuài tiě gèzì shòu qīngzǎi , yán xiānqián zhǔnxǔ guò de gànggǎn bùjú dú xiǎngyìng , shuāngshǒu cóng jiēshàng dào shōuhuí dōu bù líkāi .
pairs.english: Each iron piece took a light load, readings using the previously approved lever layout, both hands touching throughout cancellation.
pairs.hanzi: 两块铁各自受轻载，沿先前准许过的杠杆布局读响应，双手从接上到收回都不离开。

pairs.target: zhècì bùliú yú xìng , mǐlā yě búyòng qiǎng zài bǎichuí dìyīshēng qián chuān xiāo .
pairs.english: No residue this time, no need for Mira to rush a pin before the first pendulum click.
pairs.hanzi: 这次不留余性，米拉也不用抢在摆锤第一声前穿销。

pairs.target: tā yào zuò de shì zài tǎ wéi wéichí nà yìdiǎn xiǎo biànhuà shí , jiāng yǐ duì zhèng de luógǎn nǐng dào dìngwèi ; quèrèn kǎkǒu hòu , tā liǎngshǒu réng tiēzhe shōuhuí jiè xìng , děng qīngzǎi dúshù huíqù , zài táishǒu , xièzài .
pairs.english: While Tavi maintained a small change she would turn an aligned screw into position; once the catch was confirmed he would cancel with both hands still touching, wait for light-load baselines, then lift and unload.
pairs.hanzi: 她要做的是在塔维维持那一点小变化时，将已对正的螺杆拧到定位；确认卡口后，他两手仍贴着收回借性，等轻载读数回去，再抬手、卸载。

pairs.target: mǐlā tīng wán , méi xiān diǎntóu , shēnshǒu jiāng tú zhuǎn dào zìjǐ miànqián .
pairs.english: Mira didn't agree immediately, turning the drawing toward herself.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉听完，没先点头，伸手将图转到自己面前。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huà gěi tā liú de dìfāng zhènghǎo tiēzhe zhuōbiān , rén ruò yào kànqīng luógǎn mòduān , zuǒ zhǒu biàn méiyǒu dìfāng fàng .
pairs.english: Her assigned place pressed against the table edge; to see the screw tip her left elbow had nowhere to go.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维画给她留的地方正好贴着桌边，人若要看清螺杆末端，左肘便没有地方放。

pairs.target: tā jiāng yǐzi tuō jìn , yǎn gěi tā kàn , shǒu hái méi shēn dàodǐ , jiān yǐjīng dǐng zhe tā de shǒubì .
pairs.english: Pulling up a chair to demonstrate, she hadn't reached all the way before her shoulder touched his arm.
pairs.hanzi: 她将椅子拖近，演给他看，手还没伸到底，肩已经顶着他的手臂。

pairs.target: " nǐ kànguò wēn xiù zuò . "
pairs.english: “You've watched Wenxiu,”
pairs.hanzi: “你看过温岫做。”

pairs.target: tā shuō , " wǒ kě méi chángchéng nàwèi shīfu . "
pairs.english: She said, “I'm not built like that craftsman.”
pairs.hanzi: 她说，“我可没长成那位师傅。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi liǎnshàng fārè , xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ zài fēng zhàn huà guò tóngyàng yìtiáo tàibáo de shǒu lù .
pairs.english: Flushing, Tavi remembered the too-thin hand route he'd drawn at Wind Trestle.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脸上发热，想起自己在风栈画过同样一条太薄的手路。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī méi tì tā jiē huà , zhī jiào liǎng rén jiāng hái méi jiè xìng de jiājù bǎihǎo , kànkàn jiūjìng nǎ chù bùnéng nuó .
pairs.english: Vey didn't answer for him, only had them set up the unaltered fixture without borrowing and identify what couldn't move.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师没替他接话，只叫两人将还没借性的夹具摆好，看看究竟哪处不能挪。

pairs.target: luógǎn de jìn xiàng bùnéng zhī wèi ràng rén zuò dé shūfú biàn huàn , qīngzǎi zhījià yě bùnéng gěi tā gēbo yāzhù , néng xiān gǎi de shì liǎng rén xiāngduì de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Neither the screw's entry direction nor a support pressed by her arm could change merely for comfortable seating; their relative positions were what could change first.
pairs.hanzi: 螺杆的进向不能只为让人坐得舒服便换，轻载支架也不能给她胳膊压住，能先改的是两人相对的位置。

pairs.target: tāmen cóng zhuō jiǎo huàn dào cháng biān .
pairs.english: They moved from the table corner to its long side.
pairs.hanzi: 他们从桌角换到长边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi réng néng kànjiàn liǎnggēn zhēn , mǐlā què dé cóng tā yǎnqián qǔ luógǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi could still see both needles, but Mira's reach for the screw crossed his sight.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维仍能看见两根针，米拉却得从他眼前取螺杆。

pairs.target: tā zìjǐ tíngxià , jiào tā biéyǐwéi zhèhuí bù qiǎng shíchén , jiù néng zài tā dīng shù shí huàng yìzhī shǒu guòqù .
pairs.english: Stopping herself, she told him having no deadline didn't permit a hand waving past his readings.
pairs.hanzi: 她自己停下，叫他别以为这回不抢时辰，就能在他盯数时晃一只手过去。

pairs.target: zuìhòu luógǎn fàngdào tā yòucè de qiǎn mù dié lǐ , qǔyòng de lù yǔ tǎ wéi de shìxiàn cuòkāi , zhǒu xià lìng liú yíchù bú pèng jiājù de shí zhuōmiàn .
pairs.english: Finally the screw went in a shallow wooden dish on her right, its route clear of his view, her elbow on firm table away from the fixture.
pairs.hanzi: 最后螺杆放到她右侧的浅木碟里，取用的路与塔维的视线错开，肘下另留一处不碰夹具的实桌面。

pairs.target: lǎoshī ràng tāmen zhī zǒu dòngzuò .
pairs.english: Vey had them rehearse movements only.
pairs.hanzi: 老师让他们只走动作。

pairs.target: dìyīcì , tǎ wéi bào dào " kě suǒ " tài zǎo , mǐlā hái méi quèrèn kǎkǒu .
pairs.english: First Tavi called “ready to lock” too early; Mira hadn't confirmed the catch.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次，塔维报到“可锁”太早，米拉还没确认卡口。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn gǎikǒu , tā què méi zhàozhe yìng nǐng , děng liǎng rén dōu kànqīng , cái bǎ luógǎn sòng jìn yuánwèi .
pairs.english: He corrected himself, but she hadn't forced the screw; only when both saw clearly did she advance it.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧改口，她却没照着硬拧，等两人都看清，才把螺杆送进原位。

pairs.target: dìèrcì tā shuō děng quèrèn zài bào , mǐlā dá yíjù tīngjiàn le , shēngyīn bǐ fāngcái píng .
pairs.english: Second time he said wait for confirmation before calling; her answering “heard” was calmer than before.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次他说等确认再报，米拉答一句听见了，声音比方才平。

pairs.target: jīnrì dào zhèlǐ , méiyǒu jiè xìng .
pairs.english: No borrowing today.
pairs.hanzi: 今日到这里，没有借性。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ gǎi hòu de tú qiān shàng , zhǔnxǔ cìrì zài tā kànzhe shí , yòng tóngyí duì yǐ hé cáiliào , tóngyí dàng qīngzǎi zuò yícì jiēchù zhōng de zhuāngpèi ; bù yīncǐ fàngxíng huànliào , yě bù zēngjiā yú xìng de shí cháng .
pairs.english: Vey signed the revised plan, permitting one contact-only assembly tomorrow under her supervision, using the same checked pair and light load. No new material or longer residue.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把改后的图签上，准许次日在她看着时，用同一对已核材料、同一档轻载做一次接触中的装配；不因此放行换料，也不增加余性的时长。

pairs.target: cáiliào yǔ jiājù réng shōuhuí liànxí guì , mǐlā bào lái de nà dié tú què méi zài bèi yā zài zuì dǐxià .
pairs.english: The iron and fixture returned to the practice cupboard; Mira's drawings no longer lay crushed underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 材料与夹具仍收回练习柜，米拉抱来的那叠图却没再被压在最底下。

pairs.target: zǒuchū mén , tǎ wéi wèn míngrì nǎ shí tā yǒukōng .
pairs.english: Outside Tavi asked when she was free tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 走出门，塔维问明日哪时她有空。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō wǔqián , zuò wán yào qù jìgěi sū yǐ de tú , ruò tā xiǎng bāng , kěyǐ tì zìjǐ zài dēng xià kànkàn yíchù mó hén , dàn biéshànglái jiù tì liǎng rén huà dìsāngè míngzì .
pairs.english: Before noon, Mira said, then she must post her drawings to Suyi. He could help inspect a wear mark under the lamp, but shouldn't draw a third author's name on their work first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说午前，做完要去寄给苏苡的图，若他想帮，可以替自己在灯下看看一处磨痕，但别上来就替两人画第三个名字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying , xiǎng le xiǎng , yòu wèn tā shìbushì yě yào gěi jīnrì de shǒu lù shǔmíng .
pairs.english: He agreed, then asked whether she wanted credit for today's hand route too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应，想了想，又问她是不是也要给今日的手路署名。

pairs.target: tā shuō dāngrán , zìjǐ nà zhī gēbo zǒng bùnéng suàn tā huà chūlái de .
pairs.english: Of course, she said: that arm of hers wasn't his drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 她说当然，自己那只胳膊总不能算他画出来的。
